g.text: Pocket coordinates, ligand coordinates, and experimental electron density are learned jointly in one spatial encoder
C: coordinates · D: density · G: density gradient
One encoder reconstructs ligand, pocket, and ED together
The learned context preserves their shared 3D geometry
